_comment: The homepage award spotlight. To feature a different product, change `slug` to any platform slug (jotform, instrumentl, donorbox, donordock, monday, greatergiving...) and rewrite award/verdict. Everything else on the card (price, link, reader offer) is pulled automatically from the platform page and affiliates.json. Set `show` to false to hide the card. Keep the verdict honest and specific: it is our own editorial pick, not a third-party accreditation.
award: Best CRM for a One-Person Shop
verdict: The ActionBoard turns the database into a daily follow-up list, which is the actual problem when fundraising is one person's third job. Unlimited contacts, and a 90-day money-back guarantee if it doesn't stick.
